merge_trajectory_checkpoints: merge intermediate VASP checkpoint files into a single full ASE trajectory file
extract_vasprun_from_zip: extract a vasprun.xml file from a checkpoint zip archive to a target directory
run_merge_traj_cli: run the merge_traj script on a directory of adsorbate subdirectories to merge all trajectories
read_vasprun_xml_with_ase: read a VASP XML trajectory file using ASE and construct a full trajectory
write_full_traj_file: write a merged ASE trajectory to a .traj file in the current directory
